title: SmarterTools SmarterMail File Edit API Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-126967)
description: CVE-2026-126967 is a directory traversal vulnerability in the File Edit API of SmarterTools SmarterMail that allows authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges. The flaw is due to improper validation of user-supplied paths in the FileStorageController class. This vulnerability has a high severity score of 8.8 and requires authentication to exploit.
